topology_reasoning.observed_device: A compact 120 um by 4 um multi-rail/slotted waveguide structure. The target is symmetric about the horizontal centerline. It has five narrow full-length rails through the center gap, plus upper and lower slab regions containing five narrow internal rails/slots and broad tapered side walls at both ends.
topology_reasoning.working_interpretation: The function is defined by coupled parallel rails and slotted slab regions rather than a simple directional coupler. Optical behavior is governed by rail width, rail pitch, rail count, upper/lower slab transfer length, slab body thickness, and the tapered side-wall access geometry.
topology_reasoning.implementation_plan: Use only GDSFactory primitive rectangles and gf.Path extrusions. Horizontal rails are straight extruded paths or rectangles; tapered slab side edges are approximated as a stack of thin rectangles, which preserves primitive-only construction without raw polygons. The transfer_length knob controls the middle center rail and is reported in lengths.json for verify_knob_response.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive-only reconstruction: five full-length center rails, mirrored upper/lower inner rails, tapered slab bands built from rectangle slices, and broad side access rails. Stopped because IoU exceeded 0.85.
